params.prompt: Locked-off static camera on a tripod: one continuous time-lapse shot with no camera movement and no cuts. In the foreground the black desk phone rings at night in the dark lobby while the woman in the navy suit walks away toward the elevators. Then time passes quickly: the city lights outside fade, the night sky turns to dawn and then to bright morning, and warm sunlight sweeps across the travertine floor, with only brief time-lapse traces of people passing. In the final seconds time slows back to real time: the same woman greets a couple at the illuminated scale model, shows them a tablet, and they shake hands. Photorealistic premium commercial, ARRI Alexa 35, anamorphic lens, natural performances, nobody looks at the camera. Sound: a desk phone ringing in an empty lobby that fades away, a soft time-lapse city hum, then warm morning lobby ambience with quiet footsteps. No music, no voice, no text.
